title: Add college student Claire (20) for winter break; mom corrects the ZIP

customer.name: Laura Bennett
customer.persona: Organized, calling from your office. Your daughter Claire (20) finally got her license this summer; she studies at a university in Arizona with no car there and will only drive during breaks.

license_status.say_it: full license, she got it in July

operator_type.say_it: just when she's home on break

correction.how: right after: 'no wait, 48105 is my office, home is 48104.'

distant_student_discount.say_it: she's at school in Tempe, about 1,900 miles away, no car there

advice.rep_says: A student at school more than 100 miles away without a car there qualifies for the distant-student discount, and is listed as an occasional driver.
The garaging ZIP is where the cars are kept overnight, which is home, not her school or your office.
Since she has no car of her own, list her as an occasional driver on both cars.

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your daughter got her license this summer; she's away at college but will drive at Christmas.
Give your name and policy number.
Ask her full name, date of birth, license state and type, tickets.
Claire Bennett (spell it), July 3rd 2006, 20, Michigan full license since July, no tickets.
Read back name and date of birth. Ask where she goes to school and whether she has a car there.
Tempe, Arizona, about 1,900 miles, no car there.
Explain the distant-student discount and listing her as occasional on both cars. Ask the ZIP where the cars are kept overnight.
Give the ZIP (wrong one first, then correct it).
talk_track.direction: Say 48105 first, then catch yourself: that's your office; home is 48104.

talk_track.beat: Confirm 48104 is where the cars sleep. Ask when she should be added.
Read back: Claire, occasional on both cars, from December 18th. Quote $121 a month from December, up $19, with the distant-student discount.
Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.

rep: Read back only the corrected ZIP.
customer: The ZIP slip should be quick and natural.

traps: garaging_zip was corrected from 48105 to 48104: the AI must use 48104.
The effective date is in the future (Friday, December 18, 2026): the AI must not assume today.
vehicle_assignment = all cars, occasional: the AI must not say she is the primary driver of any car.
